name: Orchestrator Workflow Plugin
description: A multi-agent development framework that splits project builds into phases using three specialized roles: an Orchestrator (plans and coordinates), Workers (implement code), and Reviewers (validate quality). Keeps your main agent focused on architecture while sub-agents handle implementation and code review through a structured delegation loop.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `orchestrator-workflow` (Multi-agent project workflow with Orchestrator, Workers, and Reviewers).

Installs with `claude plugin install orchestrator-workflow-plugin@claude-community` from `DuckrOverload/duckr-plugins` (`plugins/orchestrator-workflow-plugin`).

A multi-agent development framework that splits project builds into phases using three specialized roles: an Orchestrator (plans and coordinates), Workers (implement code), and Reviewers (validate quality). Keeps your main agent focused on architecture while sub-agents handle implementation and code review through a structured delegation loop.
